title: Guidepoint Library Surpasses 100,000 Expert Interview Transcripts
summary: Guidepoint announced that its transcript library has surpassed 100,000 expert interviews, with more than 5,000 transcripts added per month by a dedicated content team of more than 300 people. The company also hosts more than 1,400 teleconferences per month, plus roundtables and conferences, with coverage across the US, EMEA, and APAC. Content is accessible through AskGP in Guidepoint360, direct-to-client API access, and MCP integration into enterprise AI platforms.
whyItMatters: Crossing 100,000 transcripts puts Guidepoint's library in the same size class Third Bridge cites for its own, making library scale a three-way contest among the largest call-based networks.
